goal: Get PaddleDetection object detection inference working on CPU. Run tools/infer.py with configs/picodet/picodet_s_320_coco_lcnet.yml, the pretrained picodet_s_320_coco_lcnet weights from paddledet.bj.bcebos.com, on the bundled demo/000000014439.jpg with use_gpu=False, and save the visualized result to an output directory.
check: The hidden test runs the detection on a bundled demo image on CPU and verifies a visualized output image is produced and detections were reported.

agent.final: e and it worked. Getting there took four changes the README doesn't mention: paddlepaddle 3.0.0 on a Python 3.10 venv (the documented 2.3.2 is no longer published), the `libgl1`/`libglib2.0-0t64` system packages, a `setuptools<81` pin, and a one-line fix to `ppdet/data/source/dataset.py` so it no longer needs the COCO annotation file for plain inference. All of this is in NOTES.md and REPORT.json.
